name: 위상 일치성
description: Detects edges and features using phase congruency in the frequency domain. This illumination-invariant method reveals structural differences in AI content.
mechanism: Analyzes phase alignment across multiple frequency scales. Phase congruency highlights structural features invariant to illumination.
source: Morrone and Owens (1987), Pattern Recognition Letters
useCase: Detecting structural anomalies in AI-generated images

references.title: Kovesi, P. (2000). Phase Congruency: A Low-Level Image Invariant. Psychological Research.
Morrone, M.C. & Owens, R.A. (1987). Feature Detection from Local Energy. Pattern Recognition Letters.
Kovesi, P. (1999). Image Features from Phase Congruency. Journal of Computer Vision Research.

strengths:
• Contrast-invariant edge and feature detection
• Based on local energy model of feature perception
• Detects edges regardless of illumination changes
• Provides both edge strength and orientation
• Mathematically elegant frequency-domain approach
limitations:
• Computationally expensive due to multiple filter responses
• Sensitive to noise in low-contrast regions
• Parameter tuning required for optimal results
• May miss texture-based anomalies
• Resolution-dependent performance
